name: Disneyland Café Daisy (Toontown) Plain All-Beef Footlong Hot Dog & Potato Bites
whyItWorks: Inside Mickey's Toontown, Café Daisy serves an all-beef footlong frankfurter on a soft bun; ordering it plain (instead of "Dressed-Up" with chili-mac and pepperoncini) with crispy Toontown potato bites gives you a dairy-free, spice-free lunch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the Plain All-Beef Footlong Hot Dog (NOT Daisy's Dressed-Up Chili-Mac Dog) with plain crispy potato bites (skip the Parmesan-garlic seasoning if sensitive).
watchOuts: Avoid Daisy's Dressed-Up Dog (topped with chili, mac & cheese, and spicy chopped pepperoncini)
